spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto w-full min-h-screen flex flex-col relative

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F172A]/80 border-b border-slate-800
header.instructions: Must contain back button (if applicable), language switcher toggle (NO/TH/EN), and title. Height should be h-16.

bottom_navigation.style: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 max-w-md mx-auto z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F172A]/90 border-t border-slate-800 flex justify-between px-6 py-4 pb-safe
bottom_navigation.instructions: Use lucide-react icons for Home, History, Bookmarks.

quiz_option_button.default: w-full text-left p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700/50 transition-all duration-200
quiz_option_button.instructions: Must have an alphabetical prefix (A, B, C, D) wrapped in a circular container. Text must be vertically centered.

language_tap_translation.instructions: Wrap questions in a clickable container. Tap toggles a motion.div expanding downwards to reveal Thai translation in text-amber-500 font-medium. Includes small 'Translate' icon.

explanation_panel.style: mt-6 p-5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700
explanation_panel.instructions: Use a soft top-left inner glow and include a Lucide icon (Info). Text should be readable, explaining the driving rule clearly.

motion.reveal: Animate presence for explanation panels and translations.

images.description: Norwegian road for home screen banner, ensure heavy gradient overlay to maintain text contrast.
Thumbnail for Driving Rules / Right of Way category.
3D glowing green checkmark icon for exam pass screen.
3D glowing red cross icon for exam fail screen.

testing.instructions: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based. e.g., data-testid='quiz-option-button', data-testid='language-switcher'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application as a React web app using Tailwind CSS, optimized strictly for mobile widths (max-w-md mx-auto).
Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for layout structure but leverage Shadcn/ui where complex state management is needed (e.g., Progress, Tabs).
The Dark Theme is critical: maintain high contrast for legibility, utilizing the tinted Slate grays and Amber accents.
Implement Tap-to-Translate as an intuitive inline expansion—when tapping a question, animate the Thai translation below it seamlessly.
Integrate lucide-react for all iconography (Play, CheckCircle, XCircle, Languages, Volume2 for Text-to-Speech).
Never use generic sans fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings; implement Manrope for Headings and Figtree for Body.
Do not use generic placeholder images. Map the provided assets exactly to their respective sections.
